This page navigates the repository `docs/` corpus. It links, never copies:
every row's right-hand column is the canonical location, and the governance
test behind this page re-derives the row set from the repository bytes
itself -- a corpus document added or renamed without a bridge row reddens
the suite.

## The corpus

| Document | What it answers | Canonical location |
|---|---|---|
| ARCHITECTURE.md | the layer diagram, the error contract, the named-methods claim table (G0-gated) | [ARCHITECTURE.md](https://github.com/WangLabCSU/msuiter/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) |
| CAPABILITY-MATRIX.md | "what does msuiter cover" -- the authoritative capability checklist | [CAPABILITY-MATRIX.md](https://github.com/WangLabCSU/msuiter/blob/main/docs/CAPABILITY-MATRIX.md) |
| MSU-MAP.md | function-to-concept-to-pillar bridge, one row per export | [MSU-MAP.md](https://github.com/WangLabCSU/msuiter/blob/main/docs/MSU-MAP.md) |
| PERFORMANCE.md | the frozen floors, the witnesses behind them, how to reproduce a cell | [PERFORMANCE.md](https://github.com/WangLabCSU/msuiter/blob/main/docs/PERFORMANCE.md) |
| IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md | the engineering plan behind the current tree | [IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md](https://github.com/WangLabCSU/msuiter/blob/main/docs/IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md) |
| ROADMAP.md | milestone definitions and the delivery ladder | [ROADMAP.md](https://github.com/WangLabCSU/msuiter/blob/main/docs/ROADMAP.md) |
| ffi-surface.md | the R↔Rust boundary inventory | [ffi-surface.md](https://github.com/WangLabCSU/msuiter/blob/main/docs/ffi-surface.md) |
| adr/ | the architecture decision records (one file per accepted decision) | [docs/adr/](https://github.com/WangLabCSU/msuiter/tree/main/docs/adr) |
| ADR 0001 | why the twoBit reader rides the byte-string path | [0001-twobit-reader-choice.md](https://github.com/WangLabCSU/msuiter/blob/main/docs/adr/0001-twobit-reader-choice.md) |
| ADR 0002 | the vendor budget and the offline build posture | [0002-vendor-budget.md](https://github.com/WangLabCSU/msuiter/blob/main/docs/adr/0002-vendor-budget.md) |
| devlog/ | the dated decision and delivery log of the campaign | [docs/devlog/](https://github.com/WangLabCSU/msuiter/tree/main/docs/devlog) |

## In this site

Start at [Get started](get-started.html) for the install floors and the
five-minute path, read the [tour](tour.html) for the working grammar, the
[scenarios atlas](scenarios.html) for the applied faces, and
[performance anchoring](performance-anchoring.html) for how every quoted
number routes to a committed witness. To extend the engine registry see
[extending msuiter](extending.html). Every exported face is documented in
the [reference index](../reference/index.html); release notes ride the
[news index](../news/index.html).
